title: Review controlled-substance registration facts before distribution or dispensing conclusions
normalized_text: A qualified reviewer would evaluate relevant registration and authority facts under 21 CFR Part 1301 before treating a controlled-substance distribution or dispensing workflow as supported.

citations.notes: Part-level pinpoint intentionally avoids asserting an individual registrant determination.

conditions: when controlled-substance status and relevant role facts are established
notes: Possession, transport, receipt, or delivery does not establish dispensing authority or legal compliance.
